Project messages and recent context are processed by Google Gemini. Free-tier data may be used to improve its products. Avoid confidential details.

AI permission lasts for this page session only. Use Continue without AI to withdraw it. Withdrawal stops pending browser requests but cannot undo data already transmitted. Drafts stay in this browser for up to seven days. Sending an enquiry shares your reviewed brief, conversation and contact details with Hadi’s enquiry service.

Voice recognition may use your browser provider’s speech service. Contact links open external services under their own privacy policies.
